title: Verbal Prefixes 7: за- (start, beyond, achieve a state)
titleRussian: Глагольные приставки 7: за- (начало, дальше, достичь состояния)
description: The prefix за- carries three closely related shades: starting a process (запеть, заплакать, заговорить), dropping by a place along the way (зайти, заехать), and reaching a state by completing an action (закрыть, заплатить, заснуть).
descriptionRussian: Приставка за- даёт три близких оттенка: начало процесса (запеть, заплакать, заговорить), заход по дороге (зайти, заехать) и достижение состояния через завершение действия (закрыть, заплатить, заснуть).
intro: The widest-ranging prefix here. On a verb about a process it marks the moment the process starts, so a verb meaning 'sing' becomes 'burst into song'. On a motion verb it means dropping by somewhere on the way. On an ordinary transitive verb it simply marks reaching a result. Again, the root picks.
rules: Shade 1 (start a process): за- on process verbs → 'the moment the activity begins.' Запеть, заплакать, заговорить, засмеяться, захотеть.
Shade 2 (drop by): за- on motion verbs → 'stop by a place briefly on the way.' Зайти, заехать; often with за + instr for what is picked up.
Shade 3 (achieve a state): за- on transitive verbs → 'complete the action and reach a definite result-state.' Закрыть, заплатить, заснуть, запомнить, забыть.
The shade follows the verb: process / emotion verb → shade 1; motion verb → shade 2; transitive action verb → shade 3.
Many за- perfectives have a matching imperfective: закрыть / закрывать, заснуть / засыпать, заплатить / платить. The perfectives are this lesson's focus.
examples: Когда учитель зашёл в класс, дети запели гимн. (When the teacher came into the room, the children started singing the anthem.) Shade 2 for the teacher, shade 1 for the kids.
Маленькая девочка вдруг заплакала. (The little girl suddenly burst into tears.) Shade 1, with 'вдруг' as the onset cue.
Я зашёл к Маше на десять минут после работы. (I dropped by Masha's for ten minutes after work.) Shade 2: a brief stop, 'на десять минут' duration cue.
Антон заплатил за обед карточкой. (Anton paid for lunch by card.) Shade 3: reach the paid state.
Маша закрыла окно перед сном. (Masha closed the window before bed.) Shade 3: reach the closed state.
Лена быстро заснула после долгого дня. (Lena fell asleep quickly after a long day.) Shade 3: reach the sleeping state.

tables.title: Three shades of за- with example verbs

rows.label: Start a process
cells: abrupt cue (вдруг, неожиданно, в этот момент)

rows.label: Drop by
cells: зайти, заехать (often + за + instr = pick up)
brief duration cue 'на пять минут'; intermediate stop

items.prompt: Антон _____ подарки из Москвы. (warm-up from Lesson 6)
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 6: arrival at speaker's location. Which prefix?
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 6: 'из Москвы → here' signals shade 1 of при-: arrival at the speaker's location → привёз. Today's lesson moves to за- and its three shades.

items.promptEnglish: The little girl suddenly burst into tears from fear.
items.hint: 'Вдруг' = abrupt onset of crying. Shade 1: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Вдруг' (suddenly) plus the onset framing signals shade 1 of за-: start a process → заплакала. The pf onset form is the canonical 'burst into tears.'

items.prompt: Я _____ к Маше на десять минут после работы.
items.promptEnglish: I (m) dropped by Masha's for ten minutes after work.
items.hint: Brief stop on the way + 'на десять минут.' Shade 2: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'На десять минут' (for ten minutes) + 'к Маше' as an intermediate stop signals shade 2 of за-: drop by → зашёл. Past masc pf of зайти.

items.prompt: Антон _____ за обед карточкой и пошёл в офис.
items.promptEnglish: Anton paid for lunch by card and went to the office.
items.hint: Completed payment, sequence with 'и пошёл.' Shade 3: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Paid + and went' is a sequence of two pf events. Shade 3 of за-: reach the paid state. Past masc заплатил.

items.prompt: Лена быстро _____ после долгого рабочего дня.
items.promptEnglish: Lena fell asleep quickly after a long workday.
items.hint: 'Fell asleep' = reach the sleeping state. Shade 3: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Quickly fell asleep' signals shade 3 of за-: reach the sleeping state → заснула. Past fem pf of заснуть.

items.prompt: Маша _____ окно перед сном, потому что было холодно.
items.promptEnglish: Masha closed the window before bed because it was cold.
items.hint: Reached the closed state. Shade 3: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Closed the window before bed' signals shade 3 of за-: reach the closed state. Past fem pf закрыла.

items.hint: Вдруг marks an abrupt onset: which prefix?
items.explanation: За- marks the onset: засмеялась ('burst into laughter').

items.promptEnglish: Lena dropped by her friend's place after work.
items.hint: The drop-by shade: a brief intermediate stop.
items.explanation: За- marks the brief visit: зашла к подруге, a quick intermediate stop on the way home.

items.prompt: Лена _____ всё стихотворение за один вечер.
items.promptEnglish: Lena memorised the whole poem in one evening.
items.explanation: За- marks reaching the state: запомнила ('committed to memory').

blanks: Когда учитель _____ в класс, все дети встали. (When the teacher came into the room, all the children stood up.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: 'Came into the classroom' for an everyday entry (not a deliberate threshold-crossing focus) reaches for shade 2 of за-: drop in / come in. Past masc зашёл, the conversational 'came in.'

errorCorrection.sentence: Когда заиграла музыка, гости вдруг спели любимую песню.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: When the music started, the guests suddenly broke into their favourite song.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Вдруг' (suddenly) signals the onset of an activity, the за- shade 1 (start a process): запели (broke into song). Спели means 'sang (a song) through to the end', a completed performance, which the abrupt-onset 'вдруг' does not frame. With vocal and emotion verbs, за- consistently marks the moment the activity begins.

errorCorrection.sentence: По дороге домой Лена пришла в аптеку за лекарством.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: On the way home, Lena dropped by the pharmacy for medicine.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'По дороге домой ... за лекарством' (on the way home, to pick up medicine) signals a brief intermediate stop, the за- shade (drop by): зашла. Пришла frames the pharmacy as the trip's final endpoint, which 'по дороге домой' rules out.

errorCorrection.sentence: Уходя из дома, Антон открыл дверь на ключ.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Leaving the house, Anton locked the door with a key.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Уходя ...На ключ' (leaving, with a key) signals reaching the locked / closed state, the за- shade 3: закрыл (closed, locked). Открыл is the opposite (opened); when leaving you lock the door, not open it. The за- prefix marks reaching the definite closed-and-locked state.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The kids started singing the anthem when the teacher came in.
minimalPairs.explanation: The 'когда зашёл учитель' clause marks the moment the singing started: shade 1 of за- → запели. Пели would be the impf ongoing singing, which the 'когда + new event' framing rules out.

minimalPairs.context: Антон _____ за обед и вышел из ресторана.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton paid for lunch and walked out of the restaurant.
minimalPairs.explanation: The sequence 'and walked out' signals a completed pf event: shade 3 of за- → заплатил (reached the paid state). Платил is impf process (was paying), which the sequential 'and walked out' contradicts.

reviewVocab.definition: the prefix за- (turns the verb perfective and adds one of three shades: start a process, drop by / move behind, or achieve a definite state)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маша вдруг заплакала' приставка за- маркирует начало процесса (плача).

reviewVocab.definition: start of a process (shade 1 of за-; common with emotion and speech verbs: запеть, заплакать, засмеяться, заговорить)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Антон вдруг захотел чая' приставка за- даёт смысл внезапного начала желания.

reviewVocab.definition: achievement of a state (shade 3 of за-; the action produces a definite new state: closed, paid, asleep, remembered)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Лена быстро заснула' приставка за- маркирует достижение состояния сна.
